# KI: Autonomous Self-Healing Feedback Loop with AST Patch Synthesis & Rollback

## Operational Summary
When dynamic code or skill definitions fail during automated execution, failing the entire agent run creates avoidable human friction. Em-Cubed implements `SelfHealingSkillLoop`, a closed-loop repair mechanism that inspects error tracebacks, synthesizes contextual fixes (e.g. missing imports, sanitized type coercion, exception fallbacks), and commits patches with immediate rollback if subsequent validation tests fail.
